content: Implement controller and authorization for DELETE /api/users/:id with orchestration logic
activeForm: Implementing controller and authorization for DELETE /api/users/:id with orchestration logic
description: Implement user.controller.ts with deleteUserProfile method that handles DELETE /api/users/:id endpoint. Implements authorization checks (users can only delete own account, 403 for others), orchestrates cascade → cleanup → soft delete flow, and returns proper status codes. Uses services from T3.1, T3.2, T3.3. Write 5 MVP-tier tests (unit tests for authorization, orchestration logic, and error handling). This subtask will be integrated with routes in T3.5.

checkpoints.name: Authorization Logic Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Controller deleteUserProfile method created with authorization checks (req.user.id === req.params.id)

checkpoints.name: Orchestration and MVP Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: Controller implementation complete with all 5 tests passing (authorization, orchestration, error handling verified)

phases.name: Controller Method and Authorization
actions: Update: src/services/user-service/controllers/user.controller.ts
Implement: deleteUserProfile(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response)
Check: Authorization - verify req.user.id === parseInt(req.params.id) (403 if mismatch)
Check: User exists and is not already deleted (404 if not found)
Return: 403 if user tries to delete another user's account
Return: 404 if user not found or already deleted
phases.gate: Authorization check must be first step before any deletion logic

phases.name: Orchestration Logic
actions: Inject: UserCascadeService from T3.2
Inject: UserCleanupService from T3.3
Inject: UserRepository from T3.1
Execute: Step 1 - await cascadeService.handleUserDeletionCascade(userId)
Execute: Step 2 - await cleanupService.cleanupUserSessions(userId)
Execute: Step 3 - await userRepository.softDeleteUser(userId)
Handle: Errors at each step with proper rollback
Return: 204 No Content on successful deletion

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (5 tests)
actions: Write: Test 1 - Successful deletion returns 204
Write: Test 2 - User cannot delete other user's account (403)
Write: Test 3 - Non-existent user returns 404
Write: Test 4 - Orchestration calls cascade → cleanup → delete in order
Write: Test 5 - Error in cascade step prevents soft delete
Verify: All 5 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of controller layer
